label: Bible Study
prompt: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the _____ and the sea obey him?
verse: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
note: Right after 'Peace, be still' — calmer seas, and somehow more frightened fishermen.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Nay, in all these things we are more than _____ through him that loved us.
verse: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
note: Not just conquerors — MORE than conquerors. Paul rounds up even after listing every hardship he can think of.

label: Sunday School
prompt: After that he poureth water into a _____, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verse: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
note: The KJV spells it 'bason' — the night Jesus took a towel and washed his disciples' feet.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, _____ to meet thy God, O Israel.
verse: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
note: After five disasters ending 'yet have ye not returned unto me,' Amos stops listing and issues the summons.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou _____ me to be a Christian.
verse: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
note: King Agrippa's near-miss — 'Almost thou persuadest me' — became P. P. Bliss's hymn 'Almost Persuaded.'
